context: A doctor discusses tech in medicine
purpose: Teach: トヨタ自動車/最年少/サバイバル/プラネタリウム/温存/微細/立て続け/頑丈

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、トヨタ自動車、絶対、医療機器、絶対、参入、絶対、注目しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I've been watching Toyota's entry into medical equipment very closely. It's genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Steady, measured opening. Clinical precision in the delivery. Warm enough to show respect but professional distance maintained. No rush—each phrase lands with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院の、本気で、絶対、最年少、絶対、研修医、絶対、活躍されている、絶対、と、聞きました、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard your hospital has the youngest resident doctors doing remarkable work there.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Respectful but not deferential—the tone of someone asking because he truly wants to know. Light lift at the end, inviting response.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さん、本気で、絶対、サバイバル、絶対、率、絶対、向上、絶対、目指しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're focused on improving patient survival rates in every way we can.
lines.style: Direct statement of purpose. Calm, unhurried. The weight of responsibility in her voice, but not burdensome—practiced certainty. Eyes steady on his.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療教育で、本気で、絶対、プラネタリウム、絶対、活用、絶対、するという、絶対、話、絶対、聞きました、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard about using planetariums in medical education here. That's quite innovative.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slow, considering pace. Genuinely impressed but not performatively so. The tone of someone turning an idea over in his mind aloud.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。臓器、本気で、絶対、温存、絶対、療法、絶対、当院でも、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing organ-preservation therapy at our hospital as well. It's essential work.
lines.style: Even, authoritative tone. Clinical but not cold. She's describing something she believes in. Brief pause before continuing—deliberate, not uncertain.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: がん細胞の、本気で、絶対、微細、絶対、変化、絶対、捉える、絶対、技術、絶対、進歩していますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Technology for detecting subtle changes in cancer cells has really advanced, hasn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Speaking to himself as much as to her. Genuine wonder underlying the observation. Slow tempo. A slight lift at the question—inviting her perspective.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。新薬、本気で、絶対、立て続け、絶対、承認、絶対、続いておりますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. New drugs are being approved in rapid succession now. The momentum is real.
lines.style: Acknowledgment with quiet emphasis on the pace of change. Professional but with a hint of optimism. Not exuberant—measured satisfaction that things are moving forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療用ロボットの、本気で、絶対、頑丈、絶対、設計、絶対、現場で、絶対、求められているんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Medical robotics require sturdy, reliable design now more than ever. That's what the field really needs.
lines.style: Thoughtful conclusion. Slower pace, almost reflective. Recognition of practical necessity without overselling it. Trailing softly—the tone of someone arriving at clarity through conversation.
